lines: Fine. The line goes slack, for now.
All right. I am putting the hook away.
We can leave this on the bank and walk off separately.
I have had enough trouble for one tide.
Take the peace while I am offering it.
I would rather mend nets than wounds.
That settles it. Keep your word and we are done.
I am stepping back. You do the same.
No more threats. Let the water calm.
We can end this without anyone going overboard.
I will let it go, but I will not forget why it started.
Good. My hands have better work to do.
The quarrel ends here.
I accept. Do not make me regret it.
We have both said enough.
That is fair. We can part without more damage.
I am done fighting if you are.
Keep your distance and the peace will hold.
Let us call this finished before it gets worse.
All right. We both walk away.
That offer will not hold. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You are short. The price is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Count again. I asked for {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That does not cover it. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
A promise is not payment. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You have not met the amount. It is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The bargain stands at {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I will listen when all {emerald_cost} {emeralds} are here.
That pile is too light. The cost is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
No. We agreed on {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You cannot settle a full debt with half the catch. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I counted twice. You still owe {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Bring the full {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, then we can talk.
The number has not changed. It is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That offer leaves me short. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Put down {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and this can end.
I am not haggling over this. The cost is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You need more emeralds. The total is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The scales are not balanced yet. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Come back with {emerald_cost} {emeralds} if you want peace.
No. I know when to cut a bad line.
You have given me no reason to trust this offer.
Payment will not erase what you did here.
I am not bargaining with you.
Keep {payment_items}. I want you gone.
There is no deal while your name carries this much trouble.
You cannot buy calm after stirring up the whole village.
I have heard enough promises from you.
This is not a debt that emeralds can settle.
No offer from you feels safe to accept.
You crossed the line before you reached for payment.
The village remembers more than your purse can cover.
I would sooner trust a cracked boat in deep water.
Put that away. We are not making peace today.
Your reputation arrived before your offer did.
I will not let a payment make this look settled.
Some catches are not worth bringing aboard. Neither is this bargain.
You need to make things right elsewhere before speaking to me.
No. Leave before this gets worse.
There is nothing you can hand me that fixes this now.
